content: proper-lockfile provides inter-process advisory locking via atomic mkdir, works cross-platform including network filesystems, with staleness detection via mtime updates. Production usage pattern (e.g. Roo-Code's safeWriteJson): acquire lock -> write temp file -> backup existing target -> rename -> release lock, with rollback on error. Advisory locks only protect cooperating processes; an external editor (VS Code, hand-editing) or a concurrently-running gsd-core CLI command that doesn't use the same lock file will not be blocked and can race the write.
